answer.book: Melchior Goldast, Collectio Constitutionum Imperialium, vol. 2 (Frankfurt 1673): imperial constitutions, decrees and documents from Frederick I to Maximilian II, printed as separate documents, each with its own heading, and in part Latin Constitutions with numbered chapters.
